content_sections.heading: About ATMA
content_sections.text: The Agriculture Technology Management Agency (ATMA), Simdega issued this notice through its Project Director. The posts come under the Submission on Agriculture Extension, a sub-scheme of the National Mission on Agriculture Extension and Technology.

content_sections.heading: ATMA Block Technology Manager and Assistant Technology Manager Vacancy Details 2026
ATMA Block Technology Manager and Assistant Technology Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector with Computer Skill. Mandatory experience: Minimum 2 years field experience in Agriculture related activities. Qualification: Graduate in Agriculture/Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector. Preferred experience: Preferably one year field experience in Agriculture related activities. content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment to both posts is contract-based, and the contract period is one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ATMA Block Technology Manager and Assistant Technology Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the appointment conditions and the application form format from the NIC Simdega website or atmasimdega.co.in . Fill in the application form and submit it by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for these ATMA Simdega posts?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications from unemployed young men and women and from employees of private firms who hold the listed qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q2. Is computer skill required for the Block Technology Manager post?
faq.answer: Yes. The post requires a Post Graduate qualification in Agriculture/Allied Sector with Computer Skill.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience compulsory for the Assistant Technology Manager post?
faq.answer: The notice words it as a preference: preferably one year of field experience in Agriculture related activities. The Block Technology Manager post, by contrast, requires a minimum of 2 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many posts are reserved for Scheduled Tribe candidates?
faq.answer: The category table shows 02 ST vacancies for Block Technology Manager and 05 for Assistant Technology Manager. A separate backlog table lists 01 more ST vacancy for Assistant Technology Manager.

faq.question: Q5. Are any posts open to Scheduled Caste or Backward Class candidates under their own category?
faq.answer: No category vacancy is shown for them: SC, BC-II and BC-I are each listed as 00 for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are contract-based, with a contract period of one year.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The notice says the form format and the appointment conditions are available on the NIC Simdega website, www.simdega.nic.in, and on atmasimdega.co.in.
